scope: Read-only resource, operator configuration and source-network discovery; no physical assertion qualification

P07_P12_contract.history_requirement: Non-trivial historical corpus/outbox must exist before the timed scenario; product-generated owned prior history may be seeded.
P07_P12_contract.CF7_distinction: CF7-C readiness separately names a CNC-recorder profile with two real MTConnect sources; see docs/implementation/federation/acceptance/cf7c_physical_test_readiness.md:14.

pressure_plan: Use new bounded ext4 filesystem images and unique owned mountpoints; verify resolved backing paths, preserve shared system-disk margin, and change no product thresholds.
Keep default byte boundaries 16/12/10 GiB and inode boundaries 4096/512/128. Scope external filler files and inode exhaustion to the owned mounted filesystem.
WSL root is available for isolated mount setup; native Nitro rootful Docker may provide a narrowly scoped setup helper. No mount feasibility has yet been executed or claimed.
Do not use memory-backed tmpfs to fill through the byte thresholds: neither host has sufficient available RAM for that pressure route.

A separate data/results/model filesystem cannot prove operational Docker-root pressure. The checkout/Docker assertion needs the actual selected backing resource, potentially an isolated test daemon rooted on a bounded owned filesystem. Leave operational Docker state intact.

P11_resources.independent_physical_destination: Nitro physical disk is independent of Windows runtime storage and has available capacity.
P11_resources.transport_constraint: Supported backup accepts a filesystem path; current SSH access alone is insufficient. Neither Ubuntu nor Nitro has sshfs, CIFS/NFS mount tools, Samba server, or an existing remote filesystem mount. Provision a scoped transport/mount before backup preflight.
P11_resources.dpapi: A second actual Windows security context is reachable on Recorder and its DPAPI API is available. A newly generated owned dummy identity can prove same-user success and different-machine rejection without accessing or writing Recorder data.
